annotation.title_clean: Directive 2003/37/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 May 2003 on type-approval of agricultural or forestry tractors, their trailers and interchangeable towed machinery, together with their systems, components and separate technical units and repealing Directive 74/150/EEC
annotation.title_en: Directive 2003/37/EC on type-approval of agricultural or forestry tractors, their trailers and interchangeable towed machinery, together with their systems, components and separate technical units and repealing Directive 74/150/EEC
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 171
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 2003/37/EC establishing harmonised EC type-approval for agricultural and forestry tractors, trailers and towed machinery, with certificates of conformity, conformity-of-production checks and safeguard clauses. It contains no AI or robotics provisions and was later repealed and replaced by Regulation (EU) 167/2013.
key_provisions_or_claims: Harmonised EC type-approval for agricultural and forestry tractors, trailers and towed machinery
Manufacturers must issue a certificate of conformity for registration, sale and entry into service
Member States must verify conformity of production and may invoke safeguard clauses for serious safety risks
Exemptions for small-series, end-of-series and incompatible-technology vehicles
